segments.text: This girl fell two miles out of the sky. And walked out of the jungle.
Flight {508|five oh eight} flies into a thunderstorm over Peru. Lightning hits. The plane breaks apart.
{17-year-old|Seventeen year old} Juliane falls about {3,000|three thousand} meters, still strapped to her row of seats.
She wakes up alone on the forest floor. Broken collarbone. One eye swollen.
Then she remembers her father. A small stream leads to a bigger one, and bigger rivers lead to people.
So she follows the water. Wading, swimming, living on a bag of sweets from the wreck.
Day ten. A hut. Inside, fuel. She pours it on her infected wound.
The next day, workers find her. Of {92|ninety-two} people on board, she's the only survivor.
She grew up to run a research station in that same rainforest. That's the story. Stay curious.
